race.comment: CLEAR INTENT (8) is the top pick on debut, with two trials giving her a useful grounding and the earlier close second at Ascot balancing a latest Belmont Park third. She lacks race experience, but the profile is solid enough for a maiden where several exposed runners still have something to prove. A REAL SORT (7) also debuts and has a trial win at Lark Hill to recommend her, which gives her a genuine winning chance. Drawn to get a gun run in transit and can make an immediate impact. ON THE HOUR (10) has trialled close up at Lark Hill and comes from a family with proven winners, including Listed-placed Henchard, so she has enough background to be respected first time out. GOD SHE'S GOOD (9) has shown enough at the trials to suggest she won't be far away.
